name: N^3 Tree with Node/Brick Pools
definition: An N^3 tree (usually N=2, i.e., octree) where the current subtree is stored in a node pool and a brick pool. Each node in the node pool contains one pointer to its N^3 children (stored together in a single entry) and one pointer to the corresponding brick data in the brick pool.
summary: This method accelerates sparse voxel traversal by decoupling tree structure and voxel data into separate memory pools, reducing memory overhead and improving cache efficiency.
